title: An enquiry belongs to the branch that recorded it

steps.do: As Test KAM: Left menu → Sales → Inquiries (Financial year: All years).
steps.expect: The Ahmedabad enquiry is NOT listed.
steps.observed: INQ-00001 (Ahmedabad) is not listed; the Mumbai enquiry is.

steps.do: Type /inquiry-edit?id=<that enquiry> in the address bar.
steps.expect: Refused: "This inquiry belongs to another branch."
steps.observed: Refused: "This inquiry belongs to another branch."

steps.expect: The new quotation is NOT filled from that enquiry.
steps.observed: The new quotation is not filled from it (client "empty", subject "").
Test Director sees the Ahmedabad, Mumbai and no-branch enquiries.

steps.do: An older enquiry with no branch.
steps.expect: Every branch sees it, marked "No branch — every branch sees it".
steps.observed: Every branch sees it (checked as Test KAM and Test MktExec); since the 12 Nov 2026 register change (Branch in its own column) it is marked "All branches" in the Branch column, not "No branch — every branch sees it". Row: INQ-OLD-01 2026-04-10 TB Legacy Client Old enquiry with no branch Open ⏳ 219d Nobody yet All branches Industrial Email Edit Quote
steps.suggest: Every branch sees it; its Branch column reads "All branches".
